_comment: moderner line, MC 26.1.2, fabric (the moderner checkout's fabric-unobfuscated module builds the jar under test). fabric-api version is fabric_api_version in moderner/fabric-unobfuscated/gradle.properties. Runs the standalone in-client UI test harness (uitest/moderner-26.1.2-fabric, an independent loom build in this repository — the moderner checkout's 1.21.10 fabric-legacy engine copy ported to MC 26.1.2) through the three-stage pipeline config->build->test. MC 26.x ships unobfuscated official jars, so the harness build declares no mappings and stages nothing into mods/: the JECh jar and the pinned JEI jar are Mojang-named and ride the run's plain runtime classpath, fabric-api travels as the build's own Gradle dependency at exactly the pinned version, and the loader unpacks the JECh jar's nested PinIn from the classpath. That is why jech, jei and fabric-api all carry via=dev-classpath with nothing staged. The row declares no ready_when and no world: the harness's own runner creates and pins its flat level and quits the client when the selection is done.
